Had a nice text off my step sister Friday night. She’s just moved from Barkingside way to a Suffolk village just 19 miles NW of Ipswich. She said:

‘Do you know John Wark?’

Turns out she’s just visited her local for the first time, with her fella, and her fella got chatting to one of the locals, got on, then they proceeded to spend 2 hours drinking with said local. 

Local is John Wark. Now knows his 2 fave pubs and where he lives. Be nice for when we visit. 

Lovely story I thought.

I hoped I would be better off than I currently am at age 51. We lived abroad for 7 years , had some small wins with property and few howlers too. Moved house 5 and half years ago, and bought my wife's parents house off them at the same time. To help them out - they were worrying and struggling a bit. Built them a bungalow in our back garden . Over stretched in reality and mortgages and cost of living then really went to shit and hit us hard.  have a big mortgage as a result.  Down the line we will sell and downsize so I can retire etc.l so will be okay however in the short term things are tighter than I would want them to be. 

My twin girls are 15 and we have all the expense of cars, possible uni , deposits   Etc still to come. 

Think i will be working till I drop!!! 

Tough to see financially how some people, especially your younger folks get  on the property ladder.
I guess living in the north makes it a bit easier but it's all relative .

messages.text:
Well, the best teams generally get better as they tend to add 1 or 2 of the best lads each summer. Happens here too. Team I do, we have 4 ex-Exeter academy lads now…one travels from Honiton (1.25 hours) to play for us and train. He joined as we had a rep for being a good side in a good league. 

Our local Weymouth side, they’re Div 5 and won’t go higher. 

A lot depends on the catchment too. Here in Weymouth we’re a small pool to choose from. 30 miles east you’ve Poole and B’mouth and it’s mayhem. Loads of clubs all fighting for the best lads, and there’s LOTS of kids. Poaching goes on a fair bit. Not sure I’d cope.

16hours in a and e, some parents I have to deal with , from the news, to the walking through a town on any given day... it's easy to see so many problems.  
One good example would be Mrs burns or Mrs morsy... posting  their day to day privilege in a  tone deaf way thinking that anyone actually cares about the shite they are doing 
Not sure about my girls going to uni... will it actually help?

messages.text: I'd imagine that the amount of kids now that aspire to be 'content creators' is frightening...as for your girls I'd say that unless it's a meaningful/vocational degree at a good uni (not forensic science (which is the new marketing for lazy students) or travel and tourism at a shit uni like mine) then it's worth it - if it's just something that they want to do because it's 'fun' or a doss it's absolutely not worth it imo.
